repos_data.description: Schema.org objects turned into strongly typed C# POCO classes for use in .NET. All classes can be serialized into JSON/JSON-LD and XML, typically used to represent structured data in the head section of html page.
AgenticSystemCore: an open specification and reference engine that publishes knowledge Bundles for people and agents — knowledge-linkset discovery, a JSON-LD graph, llms.txt, MCP & WebMCP tools
WordPress MCP + REST bridge for AI agents — verified Rank Math SEO and schema writes, hashed snapshots, verified restore, additive-only gates. Claude Code, Cursor, any MCP client. Pairs with EMCP.

MCP server that checks whether a website is set up for AI the way its owner intends: can GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and 50+ other AI crawlers read it, and what does its access policy allow? Generates llms.txt, an AI-crawler robots.txt and JSON-LD, reads your Answer Analysis, and checks whether a page permits an AI use.
